title: Writing – Test 3
q1:
You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

Read this email from your English-speaking friend Andy and the notes you have made.

From: Andy
Subject: My birthday

Hi Sandra,

I’m very happy because it’s my birthday on 12th September and I’m having a party at home. Would you like to come? We’ll have great fun.

Answer

I know that you have to do a lot every day but please come! I really want you to be here! You are my best friend.

Bring someone with you if you like. Your sister or your boyfriend.

Tell Andy

Let me know if you have any questions.

Ask …

And be on time!

What time?

Andy

Write your email to Andy using all the notes.
q2:
You see this notice on an English-language website.

ARTICLES WANTED!

Celebrations and traditions

We want people to tell us about a celebration or tradition in their country.

When is it and what do people do?

The writer of the best article will win a prize!

Write your article.
q3:
Your English teacher has asked you to write a story. Your story must begin with this sentence:

It started to rain heavily.

Write your story.

notes.q1: cover all four notes: accept the invitation; tell Andy who you will bring (your sister or your boyfriend); ask Andy a question about the party; ask what time the party starts.
notes.q2: name a celebration or tradition in your country; say when it is; describe what people do (and eat/drink); say how you feel about it.
